editorial_thesis: The next useful unit of agent design is a bounded, evidence-bearing run: persistent enough to do work, constrained enough to trust, and contextual enough to survive handoff.

topic_groups.title: Persistent Agent Work + Permissioned Autonomy
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The strongest fresh product signal is not another chat surface: it is background work that persists, learns operating preferences, and pauses at consequential boundaries. This lane earns inclusion because it turns agent capability into an operating model Buildn can prototype.

topic_groups.title: Browser Agents: Hardening the Inspect–Patch Loop
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Chrome’s October DevTools update is a material follow-up to yesterday’s browser-agent coverage: it adds controls that constrain JavaScript, filesystem access, source maps, plugins, and memory inspection. That makes this a distinct assurance lane, not a repeat of browser automation.

topic_groups.title: Contextual AI for Physical-World Work
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A quieter but strategically useful lane: current product signals are moving AI from generic generation toward context-rich, high-consequence workflows in engineering, science, and enterprise work. It is under-covered in the recent archive and offers a sharper client-discovery lens.
